fullPassage: Football is very special in Europe. It is not merely a sport. It is a significant part of life and culture. For many Europeans, football is almost like a religion. Stadiums are like grand cathedrals and match days are special occassions. European football teams represent local pride and history. Fans cheer on their teams as a way of supporting their community's values and history. The excitement before a football match is obvious, with an atmosphere filled with passion and anticipation. Football rivalries are particulary prominent in Spain. The El Clasico Derby between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid is renowned worldwide. It is not just about football. It is rooted in the pride and history of the club's home city, each club representing its regional identity. In England, the Northwest Derby between Liverpool and Manchester United is equally thrilling. It is a grand spectacle, as these clubs are highly successful and geographically close. Manchester United has won 20 league titles, while Liverpool has 19. Additionally, Liverpool has claimed six European championships, while Manchester United three. This rivalry is perfect because the teams are close to each other, both have a history of winning, and their rivalry has a long history. A rivalry between Manchester United and Liverpool FC started in the late 19th century. It began when Manchester merchants built a canal to avoid taxes at Liverpool's ports. Since then, they have always been bitter rivals. This rivalry makes their football games especially exciting. When a match starts, all the fans get very loud. They sing and cheer for their team. Sometimes, they even fight. No player has moved directly from one team to the other since 1964. Football brings people together. It connects people from different places who support the same team. They meet in pubs or stadiums to watch the sport together. Football clubs help their communities, too. They support charities and organize events. This shows they care about people. Each football club has its own traditions in Europe. Fans show their love for their team with big banners, flags, and songs. This makes the games lively and fun. Football also influences art and popular culture in Europe. For example, the song "You'll Never Walk Alone" by Gerry and the Pacemakers is linked with Liverpool FC. The 2002 movie "Bend It Like Beckham" shows how football can bring people together across different cultures. These art forms use football to explore important ideas like teamwork and following your dreams.

questions.passage: Football is very special in Europe. It is not merely a sport. It is a (A)[significant / meaningless] part of life and culture. For many Europeans, football is almost like a (B)[religion / punishment]. Stadiums are like (C)[gloomy / grand] cathedrals and match days are special occassions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① significant(중요한)+religion(종교)+grand(웅장한) ← 정답
❌ ② meaningless(의미 없는)는 축구가 삶과 문화의 중요한 부분이라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ punishment(벌)·gloomy(음침한)는 축구를 종교처럼 여기고 경기장을 대성당에 비유하는 긍정적 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ meaningless·punishment 모두 문맥과 어긋남
det.tip: significant=중요한, like a religion=종교와 같은, grand=웅장한

questions.passage: European football teams (A)[represent / destroy] local pride and history. Fans cheer on their teams as a way of (B)[supporting / opposing] their community's values and history. The excitement before a football match is obvious, with an atmosphere filled with passion and anticipation. Football rivalries are particulary prominent in Spain. The El Clasico Derby between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid is (C)[unknown / renowned] worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① destroy(파괴하다)는 팀이 지역의 자부심을 '대표한다'는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② opposing(반대하기)은 팬들이 공동체의 가치를 '응원·지지하는' 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ destroy·opposing 모두 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ represent(대표하다)+supporting(지지하기)+renowned(유명한) ← 정답
det.tip: represent=대표하다, support=지지하다, renowned=유명한(worldwide와 호응)

questions.passage: This rivalry is (A)[perfect / pointless] because the teams are close to each other, both have a history of winning, and their rivalry has a long history. A rivalry between Manchester United and Liverpool FC started in the late 19th century. It began when Manchester merchants built a canal to (B)[avoid / attract] taxes at Liverpool's ports. Since then, they have always been bitter rivals. This rivalry makes their football games especially (C)[boring / exciting].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① pointless(무의미한)·boring(지루한)은 완벽한 라이벌 관계와 흥미진진한 경기 문맥과 반대
✅ ② perfect(완벽한)+avoid(피하다)+exciting(흥미진진한) ← 정답: 세금을 '피하려고' 운하를 지었고, 이 라이벌 관계가 경기를 '흥미진진하게' 만듦
❌ ③ attract(끌어들이다)는 세금을 피하려던 상인들의 목적과 반대
❌ ④ pointless·attract 모두 문맥과 어긋남
det.tip: avoid taxes=세금을 피하다, perfect rivalry=완벽한 라이벌 관계, especially exciting=특히 흥미진진한

questions.passage: When a match starts, all the fans get very ①<u>loud</u>. They ②<u>sing</u> and cheer for their team. Sometimes, they even fight. They ④<u>meet</u> in pubs or stadiums to watch the sport together.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① loud: 경기가 시작되면 팬들이 '시끄러워진다' 적절
✅ ② sing: 팀을 위해 '노래한다' 적절
❌ ③ apart(떨어져) → together(함께): 뒤 문장에서 같은 팀을 응원하는 사람들을 '연결한다(connects)'고 했으므로 사람들을 '하나로 모은다(brings people together)'가 자연스러움 ← 정답
✅ ④ meet: 펍이나 경기장에서 '만난다' 적절
det.tip: 뒤 문장 connects people(사람들을 연결한다) → bring together(하나로 모으다) ↔ apart(떨어져)

questions.passage: Football clubs ①<u>harm</u> their communities, too. They support ②<u>charities</u> and organize events. This shows they care about people. Each football club has its own ③<u>traditions</u> in Europe. Fans show their love for their team with big banners, flags, and songs. This makes the games ④<u>lively</u> and fun.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① harm → help: 축구 클럽은 지역 사회를 '돕는다'
det.analysis:
❌ ① harm(해치다) → help(돕다): 바로 뒤에서 자선단체를 지원하고 행사를 연다고 했으므로 지역 사회를 '돕는다'가 자연스러움 ← 정답
✅ ② charities: '자선단체'를 지원한다 적절
✅ ③ traditions: 클럽마다 자기만의 '전통'이 있다 적절
✅ ④ lively: 배너·깃발·노래가 경기를 '활기차게' 만든다 적절
det.tip: support charities(자선단체 지원) → help(돕다) ↔ harm(해치다)

questions.passage: This makes the games lively and fun. Football also ①<u>influences</u> art and popular culture in Europe. For example, the song "You'll Never Walk Alone" by Gerry and the Pacemakers is ②<u>linked</u> with Liverpool FC. The 2002 movie "Bend It Like Beckham" shows how football can bring people together across different cultures. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ destroy → explore: 예술은 축구로 중요한 생각들을 '탐구한다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① influences: 축구가 예술과 대중문화에 '영향을 준다' 적절
✅ ② linked: 노래가 Liverpool FC와 '연결되어' 있다 적절
❌ ③ destroy(파괴하다) → explore(탐구하다): 예술 작품들이 축구를 이용해 팀워크 같은 중요한 생각들을 '탐구한다'가 자연스러움. '파괴한다'는 문맥과 반대 ← 정답
✅ ④ teamwork: 중요한 생각의 예시로 '팀워크' 적절
det.tip: art forms use football to explore ideas(예술이 축구로 생각을 탐구) ↔ destroy(파괴)
